title: Chapter 13 — Cooking: Wall Ovens, Microwaves, and Compact Cooking
intro: The built-in cooking wall — wall ovens, speed ovens, microwave placement, and renovation selling.

sections.title: The Cooking Wall
sections.content:
Wall ovens, speed ovens, and microwaves are renovation and new-build products. They require cabinet cutouts, electrical work, and careful measurement.

Knowing the standard cutout sizes, clearance requirements, and trim kit options is essential. A wrong measurement means a wrong product — and a return that costs everyone time and money.

sections.title: Speed Ovens and Combination Units
sections.content:
Speed ovens combine convection and microwave technology. They are the premium alternative to a standard microwave above a wall oven. Customers who cook seriously appreciate the versatility.

Micro-drawer placement below the counter is growing — especially in kitchens where the designer wants a clean sight line above the counter.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating wall oven and microwave knowledge, ask:

Does the salesperson understand cutout dimensions and clearance requirements?
Can they explain speed oven technology and who benefits from it?
Do they coordinate with the customer's contractor or designer when needed?
Do they verify measurements before placing orders?
